paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz M256 engine rebuild starts from £3,200. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
Price Factors: - Extent of internal damage - Balance shaft module condition - Piston/bearing assembly condition - 48V electrical system component condition - Labour required - Parts specification

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most M256 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six M256-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz M256 engine?
faqLeft.a: The M256 is Mercedes-Benz's modern 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid (MHEV) engine, in production since 2017.

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes-Benz models use the M256?
faqLeft.a: AMG GT, C-Class, E-Class, GLE-Class, and GLS — see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the M256 differ between Mercedes-Benz models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. Standard and AMG variants differ in power output and tuning. Specific 48V MHEV system components also vary by application and generation.

faqLeft.q: Is an M256 from one model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. Compatibility depends on the exact AMG or standard specification and the 48V system configuration. We always confirm by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz M256 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on M256 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you work on M256 AMG applications?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M256 in AMG-badged variants (C 43 AMG, E 53 AMG, GLE 53 AMG, GLS 580) is within our workshop capability.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an M256 from a GLE 450?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M256 in the GLE-Class (both GLE 450 and GLE 53 AMG) is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Mercedes-Benz M256 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Mercedes-Benz if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an M256 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most M256 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given the complexity of the M256's 48V mild-hybrid system — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
